verdict.rationale: Background automations are a fair question for a cloud file-storage product, so the axis applies. The evidence shows no OneDrive feature that lets a user set up autonomous automations such as rules, flows or scheduled jobs. Graph change notifications and delta queries are developer building blocks a developer could use to build such automations, not the capability itself, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
